column3: The prayer “Father, forgive them …” is printed in double brackets in the critical text; BSB includes it, as does the Textus Receptus.
BSB follows the critical text without “in Greek, Latin, and Hebrew letters” of the Textus Receptus (Ἑλληνικοῖς).
BSB’s explicit “Jesus” matches the Textus Receptus (Ἰησοῦς); the critical text has no name.
“Home” specifies the destination of their return.
